title: Dyson V15 deals UK: cheapest prices for the V15 Detect, Total Clean and Submarine
description: Where the Dyson V15 Detect is cheapest today, which model to buy, last Black Friday's prices and the price worth paying. Checked 16 November 2026.
intro:

body:
## Which Dyson V15 should you buy?

Every V15 Detect shares the same motor, a run time of up to 60 minutes and a 0.77-litre bin. They also share the two features that set the V15 apart from cheaper Dysons: a head that shines a thin blade of light across hard floors to show up fine dust, and a sensor that counts dust particles and turns the suction up or down to match. The differences are in the box:

- **V15 Detect Absolute:** the standard bundle, with the light-up Fluffy Optic head, the Torque Drive head for carpets, a mini motorised tool and a crevice tool. The Hair Screw tool is sold separately.
- **V15 Detect Absolute+ / Total Clean / Extra:** these versions add the Hair Screw tool (a small motorised head that doesn't tangle with long hair), and some swap the carpet head for Dyson's Digital Motorbar. They're worth it for pet owners when they cost the same as the plain Absolute, as the Total Clean does today.
- **V15s Detect Submarine:** everything above plus a wet roller head that mops up spills and stains on hard floors. Only worth the extra £150 to £250 if you have a lot of hard flooring.

Dyson's newer **V16 Piston Animal** has a longer 70-minute run time and a bigger, self-compressing bin, and launched at £749.99 in September 2025. Unless it's on a deep discount, the V15 is the better value. If you want something lighter for a flat, our [Shark vs Dyson cordless guide](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/) covers the V12 and Shark's rivals.

## What's a good price for a Dyson V15?

These are the prices worth paying, based on what each model has sold for:

- **V15 Detect Absolute:** under **£480** is good; **£449 or less** is excellent (AO had it at £449 on 16 November). It was £499 at Currys on Black Friday 2025 and £479 at John Lewis in 2024.
- **V15 Detect Total Clean / Absolute+ / Extra:** around **£480 to £500**. The V15 Extra was £479.99 at Dyson last Black Friday, with a free Floor Dok.
- **V15s Detect Submarine:** **£599**. It hit £599 at John Lewis, Currys and Dyson last Black Friday, which Expert Reviews called the only real discount it had seen.

The usual price for the Absolute is £649.99, so ignore any 'was' price above that.

## When do Dyson V15 prices drop?

The biggest cuts usually come in the second half of November, through Black Friday on 27 November and Cyber Monday on 30 November. Dyson also discounts in its spring and summer sales. This year, Dyson's Black Friday sale started early in November and the V15 Absolute fell to £449 at AO on 16 November before going back up to £479. Expect it to bounce between £449 and £480 until Cyber Monday. The Submarine is the exception: it hasn't been cut yet, and last year's £599 suggests it will be.

AO says the V15 Absolute was sold at a higher price from 19 November to 23 December last year, a sign that Black Friday prices don't always last into December.

## Where to buy

AO, Argos and John Lewis usually match each other within a few pounds. Buying direct from Dyson gets you the free two-year guarantee and Dyson's own customer service, though all genuine UK retailers sell the same guaranteed product. Register your vacuum with Dyson after buying either way. Be wary of marketplace sellers on eBay or Amazon offering 'new' V15s far below £449, and check whether the listing is a grey import with a non-UK plug or charger.

Dyson also sells refurbished V15s with a one-year guarantee, which can save a lot if you don't mind a used machine. Prices vary by stock, so check the Dyson refurbished pages before you buy new.

For every Dyson deal, including Airwraps and air purifiers, see our [Dyson Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/), or our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).

### What is the cheapest Dyson V15 right now?

The V15 Detect Absolute at £479 at AO and Very (checked 17 November 2026). Argos is £479.99. It was £449 at AO on 16 November, so it's worth waiting a day or two if you can.

### Is the Dyson V15 worth it over the V12?

If you have a house with carpets, yes. The V15 has more suction, a bigger bin and a longer run time. The V12 is lighter and fine for a flat with mostly hard floors.

### Does the Dyson V15 Detect still have a laser?

Dyson now describes it as a 'blade of light' rather than a laser, but it's the same idea: a green light across the floor that makes fine dust visible.

### Will the Dyson V15 be cheaper on Black Friday?

The Absolute is £479 today and dipped to £449 on 16 November, so another drop to about £449 is likely before Cyber Monday. The V15s Submarine is still at full price and is the one to wait for.

### Which V15 is best for pet hair?

Any version with the Hair Screw tool: the Total Clean, Absolute+ or Extra. Today the Total Clean is the same price as the plain Absolute at Argos, so it's the better buy for pet owners.
